mentions.name: Orlog
mentions.description: A personality test called Orlog that helps product managers discover what kind of PM personality they are, with results grounded in the actual work of product management rather than generic personality assessments.
mentions.problem: Existing personality tests do not map people to the actual work of Product Management.
mentions.audience: Product managers seeking to understand their personality type in the context of product management work.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built a test for the same and its called Orlog. You can check it out here: https://orlog-test.netlify.app/
